local_default: records are written to $KAMANU_RECORDS_DIR or ~/.kamanu/records and never uploaded by hunt or check
share: kamanu share RECORD.json: hold for third-party engines (KAMANU_SHARE_HOLD_DAYS, default 30, from the maintainer-notified date), redaction, full preview, yes on stdin, one POST to $KAMANU_SHARE_URL
note: no record is committed here: the records hunt and check write locally come from the bundled reference adapter (live false) and never land under evidence/
